title: Ask a fresh question against pinned evidence
steps: Open Ask OKF and enter the exact capital question specified in the instructions.
Use 64 records, 128 relationships, depth 6 and 524288 bytes.
Capture the completed result and save its actual receipt; do not call an answer model.
permitted_claim: This is a new evidence assembly, with explicit selection and budget limits.
does_not_establish: A retrieval improvement does not establish an accurate AI answer or legal completeness.
fallback: Use the original retained observation, labelled historical; do not report a failed or unavailable fresh run as successful.
classification: fresh deterministic evidence assembly; no AI answer
